[EVENT] User is curious about tips for properly caring for new shoes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for caring for shoes:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Clean them regularly with a soft brush or cloth.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Dry them naturally, avoiding direct sunlight and heat.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Store them in a cool, dry place away from sunlight.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Use a shoe tree or stuff them with newspaper to maintain shape.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Avoid extreme temperatures.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Rotate shoes if multiple pairs are available.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Check and replace insoles regularly.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Use a waterproofing spray.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Avoid over-tightening the laces.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Get them serviced if issues arise.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended to replace shoes every 300-500 miles or every 3-6 months.
